diagnosis.explanation: Cross-sectional decision scores use the same-timestamp prediction population and have no temporal history window.

semantics.decision: OHLCV and factor known through close t
semantics.executionRisk: the final post-drift book is rechecked through close t; risk compliance bypasses the no-trade band with minimum proportional scale-down
semantics.factorTransform: prediction-mode-causal-percentile-v2 / cross-sectional / same-timestamp-prediction-population; percentile state machine with inverse-volatility conviction sizing followed by a causal one-sided portfolio volatility ceiling
semantics.liquidityCapacity: 20-observation trailing average close-times-volume through decision close; exact executed trade weights inverted at 1% and 5% participation; contextual only
semantics.noTrade: retain drifted book below 0.05 one-way turnover
semantics.portfolio: dollar-neutral over authorized tradable assets; gross limit 1.0; max abs weight 0.3; unused directional budget and risk-governor reductions remain cash
semantics.positionLifecycle: contiguous executed-weight signs clipped to fixed splits; linear close/open cost allocated exactly; MFE/MAE is daily cumulative additive return contribution
semantics.researchHorizonRole: fixed question identity and disclosure; sequential one-bar accounting is not a direct multi-bar forecast
semantics.riskGovernor: 60-bar trailing covariance through close t; minimum 20 observations; annualized volatility ceiling 0.15; scale-down only
semantics.signalState: long entry/exit 0.75/0.55; short entry/exit 0.25/0.45; direct reversal at opposite entry
semantics.split: dataset-fixed chronological 60/20/20 with one-bar boundary purge
semantics.testRole: visible diagnostic evidence; never enters candidate selection
